verdict.rationale: The Empresa Online service page states up front which authentication credential each user class must use: Cartão de Cidadão or Chave Móvel Digital for anyone, a professional certificate for lawyers, notaries and solicitors, and passport-linked CMD or eIDAS for foreign citizens. It also names the extra prerequisites for foreign corporate partners (Portuguese NIPC/NIF, home-country registry certificate) and the requirement that all partners digitally sign the pact. missing for 10: published steps for obtaining the credentials themselves (e.g. how to activate a passport-linked Chave Móvel Digital), up-front framing of the post-submission data-sharing authorization step, and hands-on corroboration that no undisclosed identity steps appear mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
